svg.aria-label: Vehicle Speed & Plate Recognition (VISION): Tracks vehicles across frames to estimate speed, then pulls the plate from a moving, badly-lit image. Most of the work is the frames where it shouldn't fire. Built with Python · OpenCV · TensorFlow. AI-Powered Enterprise OS (PLATFORM): Orders, stock, staff, reporting — the system a company runs its day on, with an assistant inside that answers questions about the business, not about the manual. Built with Django · PostgreSQL · LLM APIs. Face Recognition Attendance (VISION): Students enrol once; the system encodes their face. A webcam then handles check-in and check-out, writing timestamped rows by department and class. Built with Django · OpenCV · face_recognition · NumPy. Virtual Hair Colour Try-On (VISION): Segment the hair, keep the highlights, change the colour — and have it still look like hair. Vision work where the acceptance test is the human eye. Built with Python · OpenCV · image segmentation. Multilingual E-Commerce Platform (PLATFORM): Catalogue, media, orders, and translations that hold up across languages — plus an admin the client can actually run without me. Built with Django · PostgreSQL · i18n. Offline Recipe Keeper (MOBILE): A Flutter app that works on a train with no signal. Local storage, a clean interface, nothing that phones home to be useful. Built with Flutter · Dart · local storage.
